highlights.title: Older Safari opens your board
highlights.line: In Safari older than 16.4, a computer opened through Kosmos+ shows its board, not a signed-out page. Pictures and downloads do not load yet.

highlights.title: An agent's name can hold an apostrophe
highlights.line: A name like O'Brien's helper now works when you make an agent: the name you see keeps the apostrophe.

highlights.title: A remote sign-in lasts until it ends
highlights.line: From a phone or another computer, a sign-in with your authenticator code now lasts until it ends, so making an agent stops asking again.

highlights.title: Update Kosmos from the board on Linux
highlights.line: On an installed Linux computer, Update on the board now installs a newer Kosmos, with no command to type.

highlights.title: Kosmos Cloud machines stay up to date
highlights.line: A Kosmos Cloud machine installs the newest release each night, skipping a night when an agent is working. Settings can turn it off.
